correctness.rationale: For k chosen subsets, Venn-cell size vectors classify tuples under base-atom permutations. Complete rank-r Hintikka types recursively record order atoms and the *set* of successor types under all possible cell splits; multiplicity of successor realizations does not matter. This recursion gives seven different rank-3 empty types for n=0..6 and equality n=6,7,8,9. Independently implemented finite orbit recursion through n=8, returning seven types, rather than treating verification_output.txt as proof. For n,m>=2^q an explicit q-round EF strategy maintains corresponding cell counts equal or both >=2^(q-j), recursively matches split counts; when q=3, all n>=8 are equivalent. Since P_6 equivalent P_8 by exact finite recursion, transitivity yields the infinite tail n>=6. The language omits Boolean operations/constants so separating formulas from the richer language cannot be silently reused. Boundary n=0 and equality inclusion atoms addressed. Finite n<=9 exact recursion plus infinite EF game is the complete proof.
